level = 8.90 (checker fix, was 8.85). The plan prints +8.85 (fpA and fpB), but section א-א (secB) dimensions the roof slab top as +8.90 with a 150 parapet to +10.40 (6.00+2.65+0.25; ממ"ד 6.03+2.62+0.25), the north elevation marks +8.90 and +10.40, and the task facts give +8.90. h of the parapets is measured from 8.90 (main 1.50 = the section's 150), so their tops land on the printed +10.40 / +10.60 / +10.30 as before; only the slab moved up 5 cm.

Roof falls: 'שיפוע 1.5%' with screed thickness marks +7 (at the two roof outlets: NW corner and SW bump), +10 (SW corner of the main roof), +12 (SE corner of the SW bump), +14 (west edge on the ridge line z~6.95), +24 (beside the hatch), +25 (SE corner of the SE bump), +31 / +34 (east edge and NE corner). Finished roof therefore ~+8.97..+9.24 above the +8.90 slab.

walls = parapets standing on the roof slab only (base = level 8.90). The parapets of the lower terraces that are drawn on this sheet are in 'lower_walls' with an explicit 'base' level (2.98 or 5.98) and 'top' - they belong to the +3.00 / +6.00 floors (E2 / E3 model them already) and must not be placed at roof level; they are kept here for reference only.

Stair front: the open recess x 6.95..11.05, z 2.15..3.40 in front of the stair hall goes down to the +2.98 terrace; the stair-front parapet (z=3.40..3.60) is +10.60 on the plan but +10.70 on the north elevation (label and drawn height, 0.27-0.30 above the +10.40 parapet), and section א-א (cut near x=10.35) draws the cut stair wall at about +10.42 without a label; the plan value is used. The 0.68 x 0.50 notch (light slot) in its middle is +10.30 on the plan and the elevation.

Sheet distortion: fpA is narrower towards the bottom of the sheet (x scale 1.003 at z=-4 to 0.986 at z=14); the global registration (similarity transform) does not absorb it. Coordinates here are TRUE (dimension chains + corrected measurements), so on a plain overlay2.py render of fpA the walls appear off their drawn lines by up to ~9 cm on the east parapet and ~12 cm on the SE bump (checker's wall-face test). Checker re-verified: (1) top chain 18.00 spans 18.05 registered m at z=-4.3, bottom chain spans 17.73 at z=14.43 with every sub-segment ~1.5% short, east/west parapets lean -1.2/+0.7 cm per m; (2) an independent keystone fit (x_reg = c + (x-9) s, c = 9.0077 - 0.0020 z, s = 0.99936 - 0.00096 z, residuals <= 1.4 cm) puts every roof wall within 5 cm of its drawn faces (worst: west wall of the SE bump, 4.7 cm); (3) on fpB a plain shift of (-0.03, +0.10) puts every wall within 5 cm.

Bedroom bumps: outer faces from the chain 260/320/640/320/260 (x=2.60/5.80/12.20/15.40, symmetric about x=9). The drawn faces scatter around it by a few cm depending on the sheet and its correction: fpA corrected 2.62/5.84/12.16/15.38, fpC 2.62/5.82/12.15/15.35, fpB referred to its own bottom chain ticks 2.62/5.80/12.21/15.42.

The +6.00 floor (and its roof) cantilevers past the lower floors at the south: the bumps reach z=13.10 while the ±0.00 / +3.00 floors end at the ממ"ד face z=11.75 (14.60 = -2.85..11.75, +6.00 frame 13.15 = -0.05..13.10, both from the area tables).

Terrace names copied from the sheet: 'קומה א' מרפסת' (+2.98) and 'קומה ב' מרפסת' (+5.98) = terraces lying on the roofs of floors א' and ב'. Apartment numbers are not printed on the roof plan; they come from fpD (+3.00: 4 west, 3 east) and fpC (+6.00: 6 west, 5 east).

Outdoor polygons follow wall centrelines; 'area_outer' gives the outer-face area. Check against the area tables (p0_tables1): +5.98 terraces 12.87 m2 each at outer faces = table 4.75x2.20 + 3.11x1.56/2 = 12.87; +2.98 terraces: visible part 52.02 m2 together; the table's 53.72 (11.80x3.25 + 5.29 + 5.13 + 4.95) also counts the strip z -0.05..0.40 hidden under the cantilevered +5.98 terrace slabs (+5.31 - 3.62 already counted = 53.71, exact match; fpD writes '25 מ"ר' each); roof footprint 167.66 m2 = table +6.00 frame net 189.42 - terraces 25.74 = 163.68 plus the two AC ledges (מעבה, 2 x 2.60 x ~0.8, outside the +6.00 walls at z~9.2..10.15 but under the roof slab and its parapet) - the stair opening 4.30x2.32 of the table lies under the roof.

The +5.98 terraces (outer face z=-0.05) overhang the +3.00 floor's north wall (outer face z~0.40 on fpD, 3.25 from the +2.98 terrace edge) by ~0.45 m; the +2.98 terrace side parapets (x 3.10..3.31 / 14.70..14.90) disappear under that overhang at z=-0.05 on the roof plan.

Stair recess side walls: the 695 chain ticks sit on their outer (recess-side) faces, x=6.95 / 11.05 (fpA corrected 6.96/11.03, fpB 6.93/11.06, fpC shifted by its -0.06 x offset 6.96/11.01), so their centres are 6.85 / 11.15.

Main roof south face x 0..2.60 / 15.40..18: z=10.15 = the 800 chain from 2.15 (final check, was 10.17). fpB's horizontal lines are straight and, referred to its ממ"ד face (11.872 -> 11.75), give 10.155 here (its 500/800/295 ticks sit within 1.6 cm of the faces). fpA's horizontal lines bow (ends 3-4.5 cm lower than middles, e.g. the north face 2.153 at x 6..12 but 2.20 at x 0.5 / 17.5), so its raw 10.19 drops to ~10.155 once that is removed. At +6.00 (fpC) the bathrooms' wall is at z~9.2 and the strip up to z~10.15 is the AC ledge (מעבה) screened by a low wall; the roof slab and parapet run over it.

No AC units, chimneys, machine room, stair housing or lift on E's roof. Items: 6 solar collectors (קולט, 1.24 x 1.50 in plan, tilted 40 deg towards the south per section א-א, edges ~+9.20 / ~+10.45), 6 vertical boilers (circles d=0.80 north of each collector, ~+9.88..+10.88 on legs) and the roof hatch. Item 'h' = height of the item's top above 'level'. The rain-water outlets / downpipes (צ.מ.ג. Ø4") are in the separate list 'drains' (checker: not a requested item type).

The divider between the two +2.98 terraces (x=9.00, measured 8.995-8.997 on fpA/fpB; was 8.99) is drawn as a 0.20 double line; the dash-dot line in it is the symmetry axis that runs through the whole plan. Its height is not on the plan. Final check: section א-א draws it beyond the cut as a solid wall, top '+4.80' (1.83 above the +2.98 line), from the stair front to z~-2.08, then sloping down to ~+4.25 at the north parapet; lower_walls now carry that (was top +4.08). E3's checker reads it the same way (h 1.82); E2 reads the +4.80 line as a future pergola (doubt). The roof plan also continues its double line into the notch (to z=3.90); the notch exists only from +6.00 up (fpC has it, fpD's stair wall is straight), so this part was not modelled.
West parapet x=0..0.20 abuts building M2 (M2's roof/terrace outline runs at x~-0.2 from z~0 to ~7.2 on this sheet).

Final check (independent re-measurement, work/ER/fin): x faces were mapped through bilinear fits to each sheet's own chain ticks (fpB residuals <= 1.7 cm, fpA <= 4.3 cm). Every parapet, the recess and notch walls, the bump walls, the +2.98 side parapets, the divider, the +5.98 sides and diagonals (outer x-z = 4.80 / x+z = 13.20) and the hatch agree with this file within 2.5 cm (notch east wall drawn 1.5-2.5 cm further east). z faces on fpB, referred to its ממ"ד face: roof N 2.150, stair front 3.398, notch back 3.892, main S 10.155, bump S 13.092, +2.98 terrace N -2.864, +5.98 terrace N -0.057. fpB's registration puts E 0.12 m too far south (ממ"ד face 11.872). Collectors: fpA centres 5.26/6.79/8.32/9.76/11.28/12.82; fpB is within 5 cm (no chain dimensions them, so fpA's are kept). Outline 1.24-1.27 x 1.50 at z 6.745..8.245; boilers d 0.79-0.80, centred at z 6.343. Section א-א draws the collector/boiler pair about 0.5 m further north than the plan does (schematic); plan positions are used.
